## Highlights

- Store a form photo as a capture. ([#365](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/365)) Thanks [@cursoragent](https://github.com/cursoragent).
- Read a form photo with Claude on Bedrock in Australia. ([#373](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/373)) Thanks [@cursoragent](https://github.com/cursoragent).
- Start and stop the Seazona history read on Integrations › Seazona. ([#382](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/382))
- The Replit template accepts a correction version (YYYY.M.N-C). ([#349](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/349))
